poet: "Rubab"

aliases: []

1
Shabeeh-e-Aks-e-Payamber Ki Yaad Aati Hai.
Namaz-e-Fajar Mein Akbar Ki Yaad Aati Hai.
Jo Naz-e-Zainab-e-Muztar Tha Maa Ka Pyara Tha.
Phophi Ko Ab Ossi Dilbar Ki Yaad Aati Hai.

2
Sakina Sughra Ko Armaan Tha Jis Ki Shadi Ka.
Behan Ko Apne Baradar Ki Yaad Aati Hai.
Woh Jis Ko Nazoon Se Pala Tha Bibi Zainab Ne.
Ab Oss Hi Mah-e-Munawar Ki Yaad Aati Hai.

3
Woh Jis Ke Husan Ka Sadqa Thi Zaat Yousuf Ki.
Ossi Hussain Ke Akbar Ki Yaad Aati Hai.
Rakha Hijab Mein Saloon Tha Jis Ko Zainab Ne.
Aab Oss Hi Laila Ke Dilbar Ki Yaad Aati Hai.

4
:UMAIR KAZMI: Yaad Aati Nainawa Mujh Ko.
 Rubab Jab Kabhi Sarwar Ki Yaad Aati Hai.
Poetess::Rubab Fatima:
Salam Khuwan::Umair Kazmi:

from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/shabeeh-e-aks-e-payamber-ki-yaad-aati-hai-tajpoints-7f84c37901c48c744a66.md')
_, metadata, body = p.read_text().split('---', 2)
roman = metadata.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)[1]
old = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', f'HEAD:{p}'], text=True).split('---', 2)[2].split('Poetess::', 1)[0]
def blocks(s):
    return [[line.strip() for line in block.splitlines()][1:] for block in s.strip().split('\\n\\n')]
assert [len(b) for b in blocks(roman)] == [len(b) for b in blocks(body)] == [4,4,4,2]
assert [[line.rstrip('.').casefold() for line in b] for b in blocks(old)] == [[line.casefold() for line in b] for b in blocks(roman)]
print('Verified 14 matching verse positions and preserved Roman wording.')

item.text:
Reconstructed all 14 verses in Urdu script and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. Both editions follow the same four-stanza structure. Updated the Urdu title and right-to-left direction, removed the `noUrdu` tag, and moved the poet and reciter credits into metadata.

I rendered “Payamber” as پیمبر and “Nainawa” as نینوا.
